description: Verify a crypto payment / transaction confirmation: given a tx hash on Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism or Ethereum returns status, confirmations, native value and decoded USDC transfers; with to and min_usdc it answers whether the recipient received at least that amount. $0.01 USDC on Base via x402. Price: $0.01. First call returns the x402 PaymentRequired (no charge); retry with payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

x402_payment.description: Optional. Base64 x402 v2 PaymentPayload, for clients that cannot set params._meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to get the exact price.

name: verify_crypto_payment
title: Verify an on-chain payment (tx confirmation)
